messages:
maya (PM): quick sync request — we have a customer-driven ask for a paid private pilot. requirements: VPC private control plane, reserved capacity (~4 GPUs steady, bursts to 8), 99.9% availability SLA, HSM/KMS for keys, and per-tenant billing. need alignment across runtime/infra/security/sre + a launch gating checklist. who can pick this up?

sam (Eng Runtime): can do the runtime side. need the target throughput and typical sequence lengths. also want to know acceptable p95 latency for generation.

maya (PM): thanks. target QPS for pilot: 12 steady, up to 40 burst. median seq len ~256 tokens, heavy tails to 1024 for some jobs. p95 target <= 500ms for short prompts (<128) and <= 1.5s for longer.

lee (Eng Infra): infra questions: are we doing dedicated pools per-tenant or multi-tenant on dedicated infra? cost/ownership implications differ.

maya (PM): prefer a single dedicated pool with soft isolation (namespace-level) for MVP to reduce ops. customer expects data isolation and audit logs but not full physical isolation yet.

nina (Security): audit & compliance: need encrypted-at-rest backups, KMS integration (customer keys preferred), and 1 year of immutable audit logs. will need design review and threat model. any PCI/PHI scope?

maya (PM): no PCI/PHI for pilot. customer is fintech but not storing cardholder data here. they do require customer-managed keys (BYOK).

raj (SRE): prewarm and autoscaling notes: bursting to 8 GPUs means prewarm policy for cold starts. suggest warm buffer of 2 GPUs per region and a fast spin-up path. also need runbook for capacity exhaustion and fallback model.

sam (Eng Runtime): runtime can support KV-cache sharing and prefix caching to hit latency. but for BYOK with HSM calls we need to avoid per-request HSM roundtrips — we'll cache DEKs locally in secure memory after attestation. nina, is that acceptable?

nina (Security): ok if we have an attestation handshake and ephemeral DEKs stored in TEE or secure enclave memory. ops must rotate keys and record rotations in audit logs. add HSM usage quota to SLA.

ana (Solutions): onboarding flow: we'll need a customer-facing checklist and a small integration guide with curl examples for model pinning and billing metering. can we have a simple canary config? e.g.,

```
# example canary rollout
route: beta-tenant-1
canary_pct: 10
model_variant: redwood-4x-q4_0
fallback: redwood-4x-compat
```

lee (Eng Infra): alloc questions: if we keep a single pool, we need tenant quotas and admission control. propose to reserve 2 GPUs for control and shard the rest by token-rate. also need to estimate egress network e2e.

sam (Eng Runtime): agree. also call out quantization profile: recommend q4_0 for pilot to hit cost targets, but provide a cpu-fallback model for tiny requests. will surface perf profiles by seq length.

maya (PM): great. let's capture action items and gating criteria. short list: 
- runtime: perf profile + DEK attestation design (sam)
- infra: quota/admission + prewarm plan + cost estimate (lee)
- security: BYOK + key rotation & audit design doc (nina)
- sre: prewarm runbook + fallback playbook + oncall rotations (raj)
- solutions: onboarding guide + canary config + billing events (ana)

gating criteria (must pass before pilot):
1) automated smoke with 1000 short requests under target p95 
2) BYOK attestation + proof of DEK lifecycle logs 
3) load test showing burst to 40 QPS with <2s 95th for long sequences
4) runbook & rollback tested in staging

maya (PM): timeline proposal: 3 weeks for prototypes (perf + BYOK PoC), then 1 week for infra and runbook, and 1 week for customer onboarding and dry-run. realistic?

lee (Eng Infra): 3+1+1 sounds tight but ok if we parallelize. need cost estimate by EOD Friday to confirm pool sizing.

sam (Eng Runtime): starting perf tests tomorrow. will post perf matrix to the thread (link).

nina (Security): I'll schedule a 30-min design review Thurs. invite sent.

raj (SRE): I'll draft the prewarm runbook and simulate failure modes in staging next week.

ana (Solutions): I'll draft the onboarding checklist and sample curl snippets. will pair with sam on canary examples.

maya (PM): perfect. owners above — let's reconvene Mon 10am. if anyone can't make it, drop an update here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 3743576400 (Mon 10:00)

sam (Eng Runtime): noted. sharing initial perf numbers shortly.

lee (Eng Infra): will post cost sketch by Fri EOD.

nina (Security): adding compliance checklist to the shared doc.

raj (SRE): adding runbook draft to ops-playbooks.

maya (PM): thanks everyone — excited to get this pilot moving.
